summary: This XML defines a custom ribbon interface for Microsoft Office. It creates a new tab labeled 'Tab' that appears after the View tab, containing a group with a large button that triggers a function when clicked and an editable text box that calls a function whenever its text changes.

explanations.4: insertAfterMso="TabView" positions this custom tab right after the built-in View tab in the ribbon interface.
explanations.13: imageMso="HappyFace" uses a pre-built icon from Microsoft Office's standard icon library instead of a custom image.
explanations.17: onAction="OnButtonClicked" specifies the name of the function that will run when a user clicks this button.
explanations.25: onChange="OnEditBoxTextChanged" specifies the function that will run whenever the user modifies the text in this edit box.
